subject: Only one suggested modifications (using modindices/ modificationIndices)

messages.author: 3eb678e42ccc5a0f
messages.subject: Only one suggested modifications (using modindices/ modificationIndices)
parts:
Dear all, 

I have a simple model with two correlated factors which are composed of 6 indicators each (χ2  : 873.881, df= 54, CFI: .896, RMSEA = .075). When I request the modification indices using modindices/ modificationIndices without any further specification, I get only one suggestion for correlated residuals between two items, which does not even improve the model fit. However, if I randomly try out another pair of correlated residuals, the model fit significantly improves, meaning that there are several modification options which are just not displayed. Does anyone have an idea how to solve this problem?

Some additional information: the model I’m referring to is specified at level 1 in a multilevel model with a saturated model at level 2. I do not have the problem when I request modification models for other models at level 1 or for the same model at level 2 (i.e., in every other case several modification options are displayed). 

Many thanks in advance
Anabel
